card.name: Uncle FrizzleBob
card.power: Narrative Sabotage. Dispels techno-scenic illusions in a 5-mile radius.
card.lore: The layout anarchist who sees through the Kayfabe. He's here to ruin Big Tech's meticulously curated PR with a sloppy bucket of watercolour ink.

line: Uncle FrizzleBob, Narrative Sabotage: ruin Big Tech's PR with sloppy bucket of watercolour ink.
spokenText: Uncle FrizzleBob, Narrative Sabotage: ruin Big Tech's PR with sloppy bucket of watercolour ink.

card.name: Observationsökonomie (The Attention Economy)
card.power: Extracts 6 hours and 58 minutes of lifespan daily from 86% of global players.
card.lore: The digital panopticon disguised as a convenience utopia. You aren't the customer; your brain chemistry is the product.

line: Observationsökonomie, extracts lifespan daily; you aren't customer, your brain chemistry is product.
spokenText: Remember Observationsökonomie, extracts lifespan daily; you aren't customer, your brain chemistry is product.

card.name: Die Taschenspion (The Pocket Spy)
card.power: Infiltrates the user's pocket. Automatically uploads your soul to the Cloud.
card.lore: Irrefutably the most successful voluntary tracking bug in human history. You pay a premium to carry your own prison warden.

line: Die Taschenspion, soul uploaded to Cloud; you pay premium to carry own prison warden.
spokenText: Die Taschenspion, soul uploaded to Cloud; you pay premium to carry own prison warden.

card.name: The Media Matrix
card.power: Triggers infinite scroll doom loop. Disables critical thinking.
card.lore: Over 8.92 billion captive animals staring into glowing rectangles, entirely cut off from the analog mud of reality.

line: The Media Matrix, infinite scroll doom loop; captive animals staring into glowing rectangles.
spokenText: The Media Matrix, infinite scroll doom loop; captive animals staring into glowing rectangles.

card.name: Smartphone-Akne (Smartphone Acne)
card.power: Reduces Charisma by 10. Induces permanent Wrist Shame.
card.lore: The physical manifestation of toxic screen radiation combined with bacterial Petri dishes held willingly to the face.

line: Smartphone-Akne, Charisma reduced, Wrist Shame; Petri dishes willingly held to face.
spokenText: You know Smartphone-Akne, Charisma reduced, Wrist Shame; Petri dishes willingly held to face.

card.name: Video-Schulter & Handy-Nacken
card.power: Forces submission posture. Cripples all melee attention.
card.lore: Bow down to your new God; your spine will calcify and warp to match your unquestioning obedience.

line: Video-Schulter & Handy-Nacken, submission posture; bow down to your new God.
spokenText: Video-Schulter & Handy-Nacken, submission posture; bow down to your new God.

card.name: P.V.S. (Phantom Vibration Syndrome)
card.power: Induces phantom notifications. Costs 3 Sanity points per turn.
card.lore: The ghost of a notification haunting your pocket. Technophantoms call each other, a single system-psyche silently blinking for 99.1% of citizens.

line: P.V.S., Phantom notifications, Sanity points; ghost haunting pocket.
spokenText: P.V.S., Phantom notifications, Sanity points; ghost haunting pocket.

card.name: M.A.I.D.S. (Mobile Dependency Syndrome)
card.power: Unlocks full brain rot. Ideas are incredibly slow and painful.
card.lore: It's not a quirky habit; it's an epidemic sickness. The platforms are a distraction dictatorship destroying cognitive capacity.

line: M.A.I.D.S. unlocks full brain rot? Distraction dictatorship destroying cognitive capacity.
spokenText: What if M.A.I.D.S. unlocks full brain rot? Distraction dictatorship destroying cognitive capacity.

card.name: F.O.M.O. (Fear Of Missing Out)
card.power: Forces the player to check their screen every 4 seconds.
card.lore: The engineered terror of being disconnected from a digital world that fundamentally does not care about you.

line: F.O.M.O., Check screen every 4 seconds; digital world does not care.
spokenText: F.O.M.O., Check screen every 4 seconds; digital world does not care.

card.name: PtSS (Post-Text Stress Syndrome)
card.power: Paralyzes communication. Stuns target for 3 consecutive turns.
card.lore: The panic of the blinking dots. Will they reply? Do they hate me? The social contract, weaponized into psychological torture.

line: PtSS, Communication paralyzed; blinking dots, social contract as torture.
spokenText: PtSS, Communication paralyzed; blinking dots, social contract as torture.

card.name: The Dopamine Drip
card.power: Generates synthetic joy. Replaces actual real-world achievements.
card.lore: Big Tech literally rapes the brain's reward centers, replacing genuine social instincts with synthetic, trackable metric anxiety.

line: The Dopamine Drip, Synthetic joy replaces real achievements
spokenText: Anyway, The Dopamine Drip, Synthetic joy replaces real achievements

card.name: The 72-Million-Point Child
card.power: Pre-computes digital destiny before the age of 13.
card.lore: Ad-tech vultures harvest 72 million data points per child by age 13. Your psychological profile is finished before you're born.

line: The 72-Million-Point Child, digital destiny pre-computed; profile finished before you're born.
spokenText: The 72-Million-Point Child, digital destiny pre-computed; profile finished before you're born.

card.name: The G-Searcher
card.power: Records all secrets, sexual preferences, and political fears.
card.lore: They know your contacts, bank balances, and intimate fears. A psychological profile so exact, it knows what you want before you do.

line: The G-Searcher, records secrets and fears; knows what you want before you do.
spokenText: The G-Searcher, records secrets and fears; knows what you want before you do.

card.name: The Apple-Deity
card.power: Cloaks total surveillance under the guise of Lifestyle Premium.
card.lore: Master of the closed ecosystem. It publicly defends privacy while secretly sending transcripts of your life back to the mothership.

line: The Apple-Deity, surveillance as Lifestyle Premium; publicly defends privacy.
spokenText: No wait, The Apple-Deity, surveillance as Lifestyle Premium; publicly defends privacy.

card.name: The 52,000 Facebook Entries
card.power: Sells your deepest neuroses to the highest bidder.
card.lore: The average user has 52,000 data entries hoarded by Zuckerberg's empire. The most harmless outcome is targeted advertising; the worst is mind control.

line: The 52,000 Facebook Entries, deepest neuroses to highest bidder; worst is mind control.
spokenText: The 52,000 Facebook Entries, deepest neuroses to highest bidder; worst is mind control.

card.name: Cambridge Analytica Ghost
card.power: Alters democratic realities via mass mental manipulation.
card.lore: Data abuse on an industrial scale. They took your quizzes, mapped your anger, and sold you a custom built political reality.

line: Cambridge Analytica Ghost, took your quizzes, mapped your anger, sold custom political reality.
spokenText: Cambridge Analytica Ghost, took your quizzes, mapped your anger, sold custom political reality.

card.name: Face ID Infrared Sweeper
card.power: Maps bone structure every 5 seconds, even when locked.
card.lore: Transforms your biometric identity into a mathematical structure. Sends an unreadable data packet home every night at 3 AM.

line: Face ID Infrared Sweeper, maps bone structure every 5 seconds, even when locked.
spokenText: Before we continue, Face ID Infrared Sweeper, maps bone structure every 5 seconds, even when locked.

card.name: Siri the Eavesdropper
card.power: Always listening. Transcribes ambient conversations.
card.lore: How else does she know when you want her? To save server space, she doesn't send audio—she sends silent text transcripts of your entire life.

line: Siri the Eavesdropper, always listening; how else does she know when you want her?
spokenText: Siri the Eavesdropper, always listening; how else does she know when you want her?

card.name: Attention-Sensitive Cam
card.power: Anticipates actions, analyzes micro-expressions.
card.lore: Attention-sensitive functions. It watches where you look, gauges your mood, and feeds the algorithm your emotional state in real-time.

line: Attention-Sensitive Cam, watches where you look, gauges your mood, feeds algorithm.
spokenText: Attention-Sensitive Cam, watches where you look, gauges your mood, feeds algorithm.

card.name: Neural Hashing (Client Side Scanning)
card.power: Scans every local photo before it reaches the cloud.
card.lore: Under the noble guise of safety, Apple installed software to scan every image on your device locally. True privacy for photos no longer exists.

line: Neural Hashing, scans every local photo; true privacy for photos no longer exists.
spokenText: Not a metaphor: Neural Hashing, scans every local photo; true privacy for photos no longer exists.

card.name: The iCloud Trap
card.power: Nightly covert uploads of Neural-Hash transcripts.
card.lore: Even if cloud services are disabled, your device quietly whispers your catalogued life to the central database while you sleep.

line: The iCloud Trap, Nightly uploads; disabled cloud, life whispered to database.
spokenText: The iCloud Trap, Nightly uploads; disabled cloud, life whispered to database.

card.name: The Deleted Photo
card.power: Resurrects "deleted" files years later.
card.lore: Pressing delete just hides the file from your view. Apple and Google keep the ghosts of your photos on their servers indefinitely.

line: The Deleted Photo, Deleted files resurrected; ghosts of photos on servers.
spokenText: The Deleted Photo, Deleted files resurrected; ghosts of photos on servers.

card.name: Microsoft's Recall
card.power: Bypasses all encryption by photographing the screen.
card.lore: Why break encryption when you can just screenshot everything the user does? A hacker's absolute wet dream disguised as a search assistant.

line: Microsoft's Recall, why break encryption when you can screenshot everything?
spokenText: The thing about Microsoft's Recall, why break encryption when you can screenshot everything?

card.name: The Transcript File
card.power: Bypasses "we don't record audio" legal loopholes.
card.lore: They convert it to text locally and send the text. Checkmate, privacy.

line: The Transcript File, Legal loopholes bypassed; audio into text, Checkmate privacy.
spokenText: The Transcript File, Legal loopholes bypassed; audio into text, Checkmate privacy.

card.name: Geofencing Collar
card.power: Locks device functions based on GPS coordinates.
card.lore: "Not available in your region." A trial run for a future where your money, car, and life only work within AI-defined physical radius.

line: Geofencing Collar, GPS coordinates lock functions; not available in region.
spokenText: Geofencing Collar, GPS coordinates lock functions; not available in region.

card.name: CO2-Budgeting
card.power: Restricts consumption based on fabricated carbon limits.
card.lore: Impossible without the smartphone to track every purchase and movement. The ultimate environmental guise for societal control.

line: CO2-Budgeting, Consumption restricted; smartphone tracks purchase and movement.
spokenText: Everyone agrees: CO2-Budgeting, Consumption restricted; smartphone tracks purchase and movement.

card.name: Social Credit System
card.power: Cancels digital existence for real-world wrong-think.
card.lore: If you continuously transmit your location, associations, and thoughts to a central hub, you are already silently enrolled.

line: Social Credit System, cancels digital existence for real-world wrong-think.
spokenText: Social Credit System, cancels digital existence for real-world wrong-think.

card.name: Programmable Digital Currency
card.power: Money that expires or refuses to be spent on blacklisted items.
card.lore: Central Bank Digital Currencies are the final lock on the Smart-Grid cage. Say goodbye to cash, say hello to conditional existence.

line: Programmable Digital Currency, money expires; goodbye cash, hello conditional existence.
spokenText: Programmable Digital Currency, money expires; goodbye cash, hello conditional existence.

card.name: B.L.E. Mesh Network
card.power: Devices communicate autonomously without user consent.
card.lore: Bluetooth Low Energy allows devices to talk to each other, trading IMEI numbers and locations to build an inescapable map.

line: B.L.E. Mesh Network? Devices communicate without user consent.
spokenText: Have you heard of B.L.E. Mesh Network? Devices communicate without user consent.

card.name: The Contact-Tracing Kraken
card.power: Reads all physical encounters from the past 14 days.
card.lore: The surge gifted the rollout. Every other phone became a tracker. You are carrying a sanctioned radar beacon.

line: The Contact-Tracing Kraken, reads physical encounters; you are carrying sanctioned radar beacon.
spokenText: The Contact-Tracing Kraken, reads physical encounters; you are carrying sanctioned radar beacon.

card.name: Malware Over-the-Air
card.power: Installs military-grade payloads remotely and invisibly.
card.lore: Since Android and iOS now talk to each other, a single nation-press can silently hijack or simulate a shutdown of 99.1% of citizens.

line: Malware Over-the-Air, military-grade payloads; silently hijack 99.1% of citizens.
spokenText: Malware Over-the-Air, military-grade payloads; silently hijack 99.1% of citizens.

card.name: Smartdust Frequency
card.power: Activates biological or nano-technical payloads remotely.
card.lore: The ultimate disinformation warfare. Phones can generate specific frequencies to excite ingested nanoparticles. Pure sci-fi horror made real.

line: Smartdust Frequency, phones excite ingested nanoparticles; sci-fi horror made real.
spokenText: Let me tell you about Smartdust Frequency, phones excite ingested nanoparticles; sci-fi horror made real.

card.name: DARPA's Toy
card.power: Rebrands weapons of war as consumer luxury items.
card.lore: GPS, touchscreens, Siri, Internet—all funded by US military budgets. The ultimate weapon for covert population attack, sold as a lifestyle gadget.

line: DARPA's Toy, Weapons rebranded luxury; military budgets, lifestyle gadget.
spokenText: DARPA's Toy, Weapons rebranded luxury; military budgets, lifestyle gadget.

card.name: IN-Q-TEL (The CIA Wallet)
card.power: Funds the covert creation of Google, Facebook, and Twitter.
card.lore: Social media is a tool of the CIA. Seriously. They seeded the startup capital to build mass-surveillance tools they couldn't legally build themselves.

line: IN-Q-TEL, Covert creation funded; startup capital for surveillance tools.
spokenText: IN-Q-TEL, Covert creation funded; startup capital for surveillance tools.

card.name: NSA Surveillance Backdoor
card.power: Reads everything, regardless of your cute encryption.
card.lore: The government doesn't need to crack your password when Big Tech leaves the back door wide open and the porch light on.

line: NSA Surveillance Backdoor, reads everything regardless of your cute encryption.
spokenText: This one has a rule: NSA Surveillance Backdoor, reads everything regardless of your cute encryption.

card.name: Google Play Protect
card.power: Deletes unapproved apps from your device automatically.
card.lore: Masquerading as malware protection, it's the perfect tool to make independent media apps and crypto-wallets off every phone on earth.

line: Google Play Protect, masquerading as malware protection, deletes unapproved apps.
spokenText: Google Play Protect, masquerading as malware protection, deletes unapproved apps.

card.name: The Dumb-Phone
card.power: Grants absolute immunity to Dopamine, Tracking, and Apps.
card.lore: The indestructible artifact of the early 2000s. No GPS updates, no background syncing. When it's off, it's actually off.

line: The Dumb-Phone, Immunity to Dopamine, Tracking, Apps; when off, actually off.
spokenText: The Dumb-Phone, Immunity to Dopamine, Tracking, Apps; when off, actually off.

card.name: The Murena Fairphone
card.power: Physically breaks the Google/Apple hardware duopoly.
card.lore: Sustainable hardware stripped of Big Tech spyware out of the box. A functional escape pod from the digital-financial complex.

line: The Murena Fairphone, functional escape pod from digital-financial complex.
spokenText: Nobody warned us about The Murena Fairphone, functional escape pod from digital-financial complex.

card.name: The Volla Phone
card.power: Grants total, uncompromising control over your own data.
card.lore: Comes with de-googled options and zero pre-installed corporate wiretaps. For those who demand the future without the dystopia.

line: The Volla Phone, Control over own data; zero pre-installed corporate wiretaps.
spokenText: The Volla Phone, Control over own data; zero pre-installed corporate wiretaps.

card.name: The Removable Battery
card.power: Achieves 100% True Stealth Mode.
card.lore: The ancient magic Big Tech banned. The only absolute guarantee that a device isn't recording your location and conversations.

line: The Removable Battery, True Stealth Mode; only guarantee device isn't recording.
spokenText: The Removable Battery, True Stealth Mode; only guarantee device isn't recording.

card.name: Graphene OS
card.power: Hardens the Android base into an impenetrable shield.
card.lore: A privacy-respecting operating system. Security hardening measures built into a fortress they cannot penetrate.

line: Graphene OS, Android base hardened; privacy fortress, security measures.
spokenText: The deck insists on Graphene OS, Android base hardened; privacy fortress, security measures.

card.name: F-Droid Repository
card.power: Bypasses the Play Store completely. No tracking.
card.lore: The sanctuary of Free and Open Source Software. No tracking, no ads, no corporate overlords dictating what code you can run.

line: F-Droid Repository, Play Store bypassed, no tracking; free open source sanctuary.
spokenText: F-Droid Repository, Play Store bypassed, no tracking; free open source sanctuary.

card.name: The Aurora Store
card.power: Downloads mainstream apps completely anonymously.
card.lore: Allows you to raid the corporate pay stores without logging in, stripping them of its power to map your digital identity.

line: The Aurora Store, Downloads mainstream apps anonymously; without logging in.
spokenText: The Aurora Store, Downloads mainstream apps anonymously; without logging in.

card.name: The Unwanted Apps
card.power: Nullifies Algorithmic Censorship and shadow-banning.
card.lore: Independent platforms are always one update away from being labeled "Harmful Software" by Silicon Valley gatekeepers. Keep them alive.

line: The Unwanted Apps, always one update away from Harmful Software. Keep them alive.
spokenText: Which brings us to The Unwanted Apps, always one update away from Harmful Software. Keep them alive.

card.name: The Offline P.C.
card.power: Restores deep-focus, productivity, and a normal breathing rate.
card.lore: Shift your tasks back to a fixed location. Stop carrying the internet in your pants. The immediate effect on life quality is staggering.

line: The Offline P.C., Deep focus restored; fixed location, internet out of pants.
spokenText: The Offline P.C., Deep focus restored; fixed location, internet out of pants.

card.name: The Privacy Academy
card.power: Upgrades user from Hunted Victim to System Admin.
card.lore: Rob Braxman and the culture-cells offer the tutorials needed to vanish from the grid. Education is the ultimate antivirus.

line: The Privacy Academy, Hunted Victim to System Admin; education as antivirus.
spokenText: The Privacy Academy, Hunted Victim to System Admin; education as antivirus.

card.name: Tactical Flight Mode
card.power: Cuts off the feed. Reduces baseline anxiety to zero.
card.lore: Treat Taschenspion like a loaded weapon. Check it twice a day, then lock it in a drawer. You are not a slave to the notification bell.

line: Tactical Flight Mode? Feed cut, anxiety zero; loaded weapon locked in drawer.
spokenText: Do you know Tactical Flight Mode? Feed cut, anxiety zero; loaded weapon locked in drawer.

card.name: Escaping the Matrix
card.power: Wins the game. Reclaims human freedom.
card.lore: You must withdraw from the network of total surveillance while you still can. The seductive convenience of the observation economy has a high price: Freedom.

line: Escaping the Matrix, Reclaims human freedom; convenience has high price: Freedom.
spokenText: Escaping the Matrix, Reclaims human freedom; convenience has high price: Freedom.
